# proxmox_access_vncticket (Data Source)

Exchanges a VNC ticket through `/access/vncticket`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_access_vncticket" "t" {
  userid    = "root@pam"
  path      = "/vms/300"
  vncticket = "PVEVNC:..."
  privs     = "VM.Console"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String)
- `userid` (String)
- `vncticket` (String, Sensitive)

### Optional

- `privs` (String)

### Read-Only

- `port` (String)
- `ticket` (String, Sensitive)
- `upid` (String)
- `user` (String)
